accounting: Adopted TER §7.1 and §10.2 establish RIO 56615 and the two language tracks. Appendix III establishes the English ordinary path, with Year 1 60 EC required, Year 2 48 EC required and 12 EC across two menus, and Year 3 30 EC open plus 6+6+18 EC required. Appendix II identifies Decoding Media Data as the replacement for Multivariate Analysis and retains Philosophy of Science. Transition variants are separate.
entryAndCompletion: The English and Dutch tracks share the Communication Science degree identity. The English track has ten 6 EC requirements in year one and eight 6 EC requirements plus two 6 EC restricted choices in year two. Year three combines 30 EC of open elective space, 6 EC each in Current Media Challenges and Philosophy of Science, and an 18 EC thesis. Current replacements in the transition table carry no extra credit. The language diagnostic and any required refresher are part of Project 1. Thesis entry requires Quantitative Research Methodology and 90 EC from years one and two. Students work in supervised research groups and submit individual assignments and a thesis. Assignments count for 40%, with the thesis assessed by a supervisor and second reader at 30% each. Attendance is compulsory and year-three mentorship must be completed before a thesis grade is awarded. Individual elective packages ordinarily require board approval and at least 12 EC at level 300.
